reviewed_arguments: Closed full punctured-cotangent relation and both axis exclusions give compact normalized graph covers and comparable component frequencies. Local support and global-over-compacts meanings are explicit.

The homogeneous mixed generator uses only the earlier complete geometry. The prescribed general-symbol phase converse and Taylor elimination retain delta cost, rho gain and every epsilon remainder, with actual supports and compact-parameter uniformity.

The actual smooth-input adjoint product is a general-symbol PDO before any L2 extension. Its finite-seminorm bound gives the graph norm. Finite graph pieces are bounded separately without unjustified cross-branch identity products.

The scaled jet lemma uses actual boxes r^-delta in the base and r^rho in frequency, nested finite Taylor interpolation and uniform higher bounds. It proves every normalized jet and every high-frequency tail seminorm tends to zero.
Representative-independent reduced-symbol vanishing gives graph compactness by operator-norm approximation. Low-frequency localized kernels are compact by proved finite-rank kernel approximation.
Every real Sobolev shift retains both proper reconstruction errors, common-support smooth density and agreement with the original kernel through the adjoint test.

General-symbol graph inversion uses symbol surjectivity, exact inverse Maslov contraction, proper graph-base cutoff and epsilon-decreasing Neumann sums. The left-right inverse comparison has its exact noncommutative sign and order.
Ordered Egorov retains beta (p composed with chi) alpha at epsilon precision, including finite matrix coefficients, noninverse scalar factors and actual proper products.

The full radial tangent splitting and homogeneous coordinate realizations are exact earlier providers. The new partial form has precisely amplitude m+k/4 and prefactor (2pi)^(-n-k/4), with no ordinary-symbol assumption.

The compact parameter family has a uniform finite-seminorm graph bound. Strong continuity on fixed inputs, joint strong measurability, integrable majorant and the actual Hilbert-valued integral prove the exact volume factor, including zero parameter dimensions.

Changing rank requires only the marked-point tangent normal form and nearby invertibility. Proper ordinary graph changes and inverses restore the original coordinates. A finite compact cover proves the pointwise sufficient threshold.

Strict corank compactness uses uniform high-frequency operator tails for the whole parameter family, not compactness of individual family members. Every corank Sobolev shift retains the full quarter-corank loss.

Three complete solutions give an exact general-symbol circle multiplier and finite-rank error, an odd-corank lifting with exact norm and sharp flat-family modulation, and a compact parameter family with exact normalization and ordered matrix ranges.
Twenty-nine exact finite checks verify the stated order, normalization, metric-scale, noncommutative inverse and explicit approximation identities. The complete analytic arguments are in the lesson.
